title: Build Grave Accord and polish the public first-run experience
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord is a cooperative gothic bullet-hell game with 66 boss identities, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. This remains feature-branch development; PR #14 stays draft.

The public first-run flow now uses **New here? → Start gently**, a settings confirmation, a manual Tutorial with saved bindings, familiar action icons, the full original home artwork and direct gameplay copy. Mode selection shows the actual fight count and estimated time; map geometry stays on the map step. Each difficulty has a distinct icon beside written assistance rules. Shop items show names, prices and equipped status, with clear coin/SP summaries. Artwork loading has progress and a useful error message. Local Practice records are labeled as stored on this device. Both builds share the polish; testing retains build details/tools and public omits them.

The result screen now separates boss clears, personally credited clears when different, rescues, combat time and class experience. It explains timeouts and solo/squad defeats in plain words. Modified testing runs show zero class XP and do not count toward records. Banked personal campaign results stay tied to their secured count/time. Countdowns appear only on timed steps, and HUD/touch buttons name the existing abilities alongside current bindings/cooldowns. Rewards, saving, participation, combat authority, controls, economy, public progression and optional Baby-only guides remain. No content expansion or General mobility is included.

Validation for source **26b76f64255a2036f8c5e6055f22dadea5f0bd94**, build **2026.10.28-run-recap / protocol 38**: full local and both exact-source CI gates pass **761 tests / 761 pass / 0 fail**, authored content/fifteen locales/RGBA, TypeScript, production build and 71 atlas contracts. [CI 123231957350](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40808165426/job/123231957350), [CI 123231911556](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40808151800/job/123231911556). Complete decoded logs/hashes are under reviews/run-results-2026-10-28/. Result tests compare real profile XP and exercise late joins, banked personal views, zero-clear defeats, timeouts and testing exclusions without awarding or mutating state. Both menu audiences and their tool/worker boundaries remain covered.

Both fresh local testing/public preview pairs pass 14 HTTP hashes, exact source/protocol/content/audience/health, origin enforcement and real two-peer combat; probes close cleanly. Testing retains its chosen opener; public chooses normally. Wiki **d4b82209041dc878e6363072aedff75055d48be4** matches all 18 pages, 34 image blobs, every public image hash and four public pages. Eight issued gate receipts and the global Wiki predecessor receipt remain exact.

Limited human feedback finds the full artwork, shop labels and direct headline clearer. New recap/HUD/mode/difficulty rendering still needs human, native-language and physical-device review; listening and final balance acceptance remain open. Existing frozen artifacts/services are preserved. The old protocol-4 hosted Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows download remain separate. Current Windows review packaging is still being prepared. No main merge, paid provisioning, hosted deployment or contest submission.
